title: agentdoctor team policy
description: Org-wide standards for AI coding-agent configuration, enforced by the policy/* rules when this file is committed at the repo root as agentdoctor.policy.json.

requiredDeny.description: Permission deny rules every repo must carry, e.g. "Read(./.env*)". A single * is literal; ** is the wildcard.

forbiddenAllow.description: Permission allow rules no repo may carry, e.g. "Bash(*)" (that exact rule) or "Bash(**sudo**)" (any Bash rule mentioning sudo).

allowedMcpServers.description: Approved MCP server names (** wildcards allowed). If present, unlisted servers are errors. Omit the field to skip the check; an empty array approves none.

requiredHooks.description: Hook events that must be configured in every repo.

maxMemoryTokens.description: Ceiling on the estimated token size of project memory files (CLAUDE.md et al., user scope excluded).

forbiddenPermissionModes.description: Values of permissions.defaultMode that no repo may set. Usually ["bypassPermissions"].
